questions.question: For about how long is the opening 'Big Buck Bunny' title card on screen before it fades out?
questions.answer: About 4 seconds (from the start until roughly 4 s, fading out just before the sky appears).

questions.question: In the first scenery shot after the title (pink clouds and trees), which way does the camera move?
questions.answer: It tilts downward, from the pink clouds in the sky down to the green meadow and grass.
accept: from sky down to the meadow

questions.question: A purple bird is shown standing on a tree branch. What happens to the bird at the end of that shot, after it spreads its wings wide?
questions.answer: It falls off the branch out of view, leaving the branch empty with only a feather drifting.

questions.question: When the big rabbit first comes out of his dark burrow, which is seen first: his hand reaching out onto the ground, or his long ears popping up?
questions.answer: His hand reaching out comes first; the ears pop up a couple of seconds later.

questions.question: After the big rabbit picks up the red apple from the grass, what does the video show next, before he takes a bite of it?
questions.answer: A view from behind his head looking up at the leafy apple tree above him (he looks up at the tree the apple fell from).
accept: he looks up at the tree
looking up at the apple tree
a shot of the tree overhead

questions.question: After biting the apple, the big rabbit walks out of the frame. Which side of the screen does he leave by?
Starting from the shot where the big rabbit stands alone in the open meadow near the end, how many times does the video cut back to the group of small rodents by the fallen log before the video ends?
In the last seconds, what small object briefly flies through the air near the big rabbit's head?
questions.answer: A brown nut (like an acorn or walnut) thrown at him.
